Seeds of Corruption [AH]
Cardtype: Action

Cost: 2 blood

Discipline: Thaumaturgy

+1 stealth action.
[tha] (D) Put this card on a vampire controlled by your prey. If the vampire
is a Follower of Set, he or she burns 2 additional blood for each action he
or she performs; otherwise, he or she burns 1 additional blood for each

> That should answer your questions.

The burn blood effect of seeds of corruption ("he or she burns 1 additional
blood for each action he or she performs") is not a cost of the action but
an effect. Vampires with zero blood ignore "burn blood" effects like Donal,
Blood to water, etc.

Result: Vampire with no blood goes to hunt. Burns 1 blood. Didn't have the
blood so no effect on the vampire. Action resolves, vampire gains 1 blood.
Net result: Vampire with one blood.
